name: snow
title: Snow from 2 pm on day 1
description: The morning forecast shows light snow, under the line. At 1:05 pm the Harbor Loop shuttle runs 12 minutes late; at 1:10 pm the forecast is upgraded to about 3 inches from 2 to 7 pm. The agent drafts the weather notice (Comms), weighs an extra bus (Operations), and re-checks every guest still travelling: Pavel Kettering's drive from the airport is now at risk for his 3:30 pm call, and Elif Galloway's car later in the day is flagged amber with a re-check timer.

steps.note: Morning forecast: light snow, under the 2 in line
Shuttle feed: Harbor Loop running 12 min late
Forecast upgraded: about 3 in from 2 pm
A door volunteer tries to approve the extra bus
Guest relations (Elif Pell) asks the backup to stand by
Nobody answered the bus decision by its 1:40 pm deadline
Re-check timers fire (shuttle load, Elif Galloway's car)
